Package threepl.netlist

Interface NetConstants

All Known Implementing Classes:
Element, GenFunctions, Net, TDECode, TDEVarList, UNISIMS, XC2C, XC2S, XC2V, XC2VP, XC3S, XC4V, XC5V, XC6S, XC6V, XC7, XC95, XCV, XElements, XFunctions, XTDECode
public interface NetConstants
This class contains constants used by Elements. Gtype labels logic gate elements for recognition by optimisation code. The enumerated constants apply to all FPGA families and all vendors and where shared may be treated differently in each case. Ctype describes the state of an element following an optimisation pass. PortType indicates whether an element pin is an input, an output or a 3-state output.
